_comment: Investor / accelerator boards (Day 10). The investor is the SOURCE; the startup is the canonical company. 'status' says what has actually been observed: configured (URL only), page_probed (platform and totals read from the board pages, no API calls), probed_partial, probed_blocked, validated_live (the platform behavior was observed working; it does not mean a complete scan was run). 'enabled' means the operator approved bounded reads of that board; it is never a statement that the board is production-ready. 'permission' stays 'unverified' until the board/platform terms and robots.txt were read. Ids and slugs come from upstream configs, the operator or web evidence and are UNVERIFIED until probed. Nothing is fetched automatically: boards are read only by an explicit, operator-approved `investor-boards-collect` run within these limits.
